description: Risk-tiered CI classification. Highest matching tier wins; an unmatched path falls back to T1 (fail safe upward, never down). See docs/workflows/ci-tiers.md.

exceptions.comment: T2 excludes apps/api/src/**, which T1 also claims wholesale, from bumping to T2 EXCEPT for the guard/auth carve-outs above. classify.mjs resolves this by matching every tier's globs against every file and taking the highest tier that matches ANY file, per file, then taking the max across files — a guard file lands in T2 without pulling every apps/api/src/** change up with it, because ordinary apps/api files simply do not match the T2 globs.

images.comment: Maps a changed path to the image(s) that must be rebuilt. A path matching none of these does not force any image rebuild by itself, but the tier's 'full' escalation (develop / release / schedule / dispatch) always builds and publishes all three.

appPaths.comment: Narrower than 'images': just the app's own directory, used to decide whether e2e is worth running and whether apps/web itself changed (for web-preview). A shared package can force the T2/T3 tier and force an image rebuild without making this true.

fullRefs.comment: workflow_dispatch and the nightly schedule also force full and are handled in classify.mjs / ci.yml directly, not here, because they are event types rather than ref names.
